domain: MODEL-LEVEL DEMO DEPENDENCIES IN italy-app-model.js + THE V2.1 INGESTION BOUNDARY
summary: italy-app-model.js is already the declared contract (5-level precedence, one REF date, one provenance classifier), but eight places still let window.ITALY_DEMO reach into it, and three of those carry facts or identities rather than pixels. Measured today: all 29 canonical windows publish a DEMO id (WIN-001…, not IT-WIN-0001); 100% of product relationships (80 links, 32 products) come from D.CASES.productLinks and 53 of those 80 have no verdict in the real label audit at all; the radar/opportunity collection is 29 D.CASES records of which only 3 have any upstream counterpart, and that upstream join is FALSE — IG.OPPORTUNITIES "IT-OPP-003" is the ADAMA Italy authorisation-expiry calendar (national, transversal) while D.CASES "IT-OPP-003" is Durum Wheat / Fusarium Head Blight / Toscana, yet the model stamps provenance REAL_SOURCE and isUpstreamReal=true on it. The two "harmless ui" joins on sources and events are measurably dead (0/31 and 0/18 produce any icon/color/order, because uiOf reads r.category/r.n which D.SOURCES and D.EVENTS do not have) while still hijacking 6 of 31 source ids into the demo namespace. The events adapter reads e.NAME/e.URL but the real field names are EVENT/OFFICIAL_URL, so 18/18 event names are null and 18 archive rows ship with a null title. The honest real backing is: CANONICAL windows (29) for timing/status, ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS (12 VERIFIED + 7 NOT_FOUND, currently never read by the model) plus IG.LINKS (219 regulatory uses, 19 products) for relationships, and IG.OPPORTUNITIES (3) / IG.FUTURE_SIGNALS (3) for the radar and the future feed.
realSource: After migration: cropWindows ← window.ITALY_CANONICAL.windows[29] (the only source of START/END/CURRENT_STATUS/DATE_STATE, and the only real crop×issue vocabulary that matches the screen). productRelationships ← window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS (12 VERIFIED + 7 NOT_FOUND triples, 10 distinct products, all 10 present in AM.products) anchored to region/windowId by joining CROP_NAME+ISSUE_NAME against ITALY_CANONICAL (28 window-anchored links, 4 orphan LV pairs), plus IG.LINKS[219] as the product-detail "registered uses" table (product × crop-code × Latin target × labelUrl, 219/219 non-null, prov REAL_FACT — but NOT usable for crop×issue window matching, no target→issue dictionary exists in real data). opportunities ← IG.OPPORTUNITIES[3]. futureSignals ← IG.FUTURE_SIGNALS[3]. sources ← IG.SOURCES[31]. events ← IG.EVENTS[18]. products ← IG.PRODUCTS[163] + ITALY_CATALOG[44] (166 unique; D.PRODUCTS adds 0). regulatoryFuture ← IG.PRODUCTS.expiry (163/163 non-null, real, currently unused). ITALY_DEMO survives only as (a) a pure ui palette keyed by legacyCaseId, (b) futureScenarios (56, DEMO_SCENARIO), (c) fieldMessages (18, SYNTHETIC_DEMO).

plan: STEP 0 — Freeze the measurement. Before touching anything, add a build-time report to italy-app-model.js that prints, per collection, count/real/demo plus per-field non-null counts, and commit the current numbers as the baseline (windows 29, opportunities 29/3 real, products 166, product links 80 across 32 products, sources 31 with 6 demo ids, events 18 with 18 null names, archive 740 with 18 null titles, searchIndex 309). Every later step is judged against this baseline. No behaviour change.

STEP 1 — Rename the fixture binding. Line 23: const D -> const UIFX, with the comment '/* rank 4-5 ONLY: ui palette (uiOf) + futureScenarios + fieldMessages. Any other read is a §2 violation. */'. Update the 8 call sites mechanically. This makes every remaining fixture read grep-able in one word and is the cheapest guard against regression.

STEP 2 — Fix window identity (line 73). id: w.WINDOW_ID. Rename dwByCase -> uiByLegacyCase (line 68-69). Keep line 71 unchanged. Verify: windows.records ids become IT-WIN-0001…IT-WIN-0029, ui still populated 29/29, and the 29 WINDOW rows in the archive change key. Also fix line 275 to print sourceIds or NOT_EXTERNALLY_OBSERVABLE instead of the literal 'CANONICAL'.

STEP 3 — Delete line 98 (D.PRODUCTS injection). Verify products count stays 166 and no product has provenance SYNTHETIC_DEMO. This is a zero-risk deletion measured today; do it early so the next step operates on a clean product universe.

STEP 4 — Read ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS in the model for the first time. Add const LV = window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS || {}; next to the other inputs at line 22-28. Build the new productRelationships collection from LV.VERIFIED (12) and LV.NOT_FOUND (7) anchored to ITALY_CANONICAL by CROP_NAME+ISSUE_NAME. Recompute products[].links / verifiedLinks / checkNeededLinks / relatedLinks / rejectedLinks from it, so the field names the views already bind do not change. THEN delete lines 102-105. Expected measured outcome: 80 links -> 32 (28 window-anchored + 4 orphan), 32 products with links -> 10, checkNeededLinks and relatedLinks empty on 166/166.

STEP 5 — Adjust the two live consumers of relationships. portale.html:3001 relRow -> route via l.windowId with this.openWindow, and render l.region || T.prodNotObservable. portale.html:3002 wins -> read AM.collections.windows.records matched on l.windowId, state from w.status (CURRENT_STATUS), colour from status === 'WINDOW_OPEN'. Markup: delete the '· {{ p.check }} △' fragment at 1417 only; leave 1363-1376 structurally intact (the sc-ifs self-hide). Screenshot-compare the Product Intelligence and Portafoglio screens before/after — layout must be byte-identical except for the removed △ and the shorter lists.

STEP 6 — Repair the events adapter (line 215-220): name from EVENT, url from OFFICIAL_URL, split DATE on ' a ', add sector/organizer/timeState/exhibitorListState/confirmedParticipation/participationLaw; delete the deByName lookup (214) and the ui line (216). Verify the 18 null archive titles disappear (740 rows, 0 null titles).

STEP 7 — Repair the sources adapter (line 203-209): id from s.ID only, delete the dsByName lookup and the dead ui line, add role/frequency/latestObservation/accessStatus/limitations, add the derived linkedRecordCount, add a model-side SRC_TYPE_COLOR literal for the swatch. Verify the 6 hijacked ids revert to IT-SRC-*. Do NOT touch the sources SCREEN in this step — it still reads D.SOURCES and belongs to the sources-domain migration; this step only makes the model honest and ready.

STEP 8 — Rebuild opportunities from upstream (lines 245-264). Delete upstreamOppIds and the false join at 253-259 entirely. Build ONE opportunities collection from IG.OPPORTUNITIES[3] with its own uppercase field set; keep upstreamOpportunities as an alias to the same object for one release. Expected: counts.opportunities 29 -> 3, real 3 / demo 0. IMPORTANT: land this as its own commit, because the radar screen still builds its cards from D.CASES at portale.html:2515 and is unaffected — the two must not be conflated.

STEP 9 — Fix the search index (line 300): index windows and the 3 upstream opportunities instead of the 29 demo cases; drop the c.latin term. Expected searchIndex 309 -> ~283, with zero entries whose terms came from a fixture.

STEP 10 — Repair the same-class wrong-key bugs found in the audit: channels.name<-CHANNEL, channels.url<-CHANNEL_URL, channels.platform -> NOT_EXTERNALLY_OBSERVABLE; news.outlet<-PUBLISHER, news.url<-SOURCE_URL; researchers.org<-INSTITUTIONS and drop crops/issues/url; scienceRecords.date<-PUBLISHED_AT and drop studyArea/affiliation. These fix 88 archive dates and 8 news links.

STEP 11 — Add the new real collections that need no fixture: productRegisteredUses from IG.LINKS[219] and regulatoryFuture from IG.PRODUCTS.expiry[163/163]. Both are additive; no view reads them yet. They exist so the product page has truthful content for the 156 products that lost their relationship block in step 4.

STEP 12 — Introduce the adapter/validator layer as a refactor, not a rewrite. Extract every per-family map() in italy-app-model.js into an adapter object with the signature described in modelChanges, run them through one loop, and publish ITALY_APP_MODEL.validationReport. Assert at build time: (a) demoLeaks[] is empty for windows.id, sources.id, productRelationships and opportunities; (b) no id appears in two families with different (crop, issue, region) — this is the assert that would have caught the IT-OPP-003 collision; (c) referenceDate is read once and no adapter calls new Date() without an argument.

STEP 13 — Create the 23 empty-valid collection slots (see the family map). Each slot is coll([], provenance, note) with emptyValid:true when there is no real source yet. An empty slot is a passing build. Nothing may be seeded with a placeholder record.

STEP 14 — Publish the view contract (see openQuestions / risks): every record exposes exactly {id, provenance, sourceIds, ui, …domain fields} and NOTHING that names a mission, a package version, a scraper, a run date or a file. Grep the model for 'V2', 'HANDOFF', 'MISSION', 'INGEST' appearing in any emitted string; today ITALY_INGEST.BUILT and ITALY_INGEST.SOURCE exist at the blob root and must never be copied onto a record.

STEP 15 — Re-run the STEP 0 report and diff it against the baseline. Every changed number must be explainable by one line of this spec. Any number that moved for a reason not listed here is a regression.
risks: The relationship shrink is severe and highly visible: 32 products with portfolio relationships become 10, and the amber LABEL_CHECK_NEEDED list disappears from every product page. Someone will ask to backfill it from IG.LINKS (219 registered uses). That would be inventing a verdict: IG.LINKS is keyed on Latin target (Agriotes sp, Cercospora beticola) and crop CODES (SUGARBEET, WHEAT_GENERIC), while the screen speaks crop×issue in English (Sugar Beet, Cercospora Leaf Spot). No real dictionary bridges the two. Any target->issue mapping written by hand becomes a fixture with a different name.

The 'Cereal Aphids · BYDV Risk' vs 'Cereal Aphids / BYDV Risk' separator mismatch means canonical window IT-WIN-0016 loses its MAVRIK EW verdict purely on punctuation. If the engineer normalises separators to fix it, the same normalisation will silently merge other pairs. The validator must REPORT near-misses and a human must resolve them one by one.

Only 4 of 31 sources are cited by any record. Publishing linkedRecordCount honestly puts 27 zeros on the sources table. There will be pressure to hide the zeros or to count 'related' some other way. Hiding them would misrepresent the coverage of the source registry, which is exactly the number a decision-maker needs.

Zero of the 29 canonical windows carry a SOURCE_ID. The windows collection is the highest-precedence layer in the whole model (CANONICAL) and it is the one with no citation. If a future screen prints 'canonical, audited' next to a window it is making a claim the record cannot support.

opportunities dropping from 29 to 3 empties the radar, which is the portal's first screen. §3 says a smaller truthful screen beats a dense fake one and forbids redesigning to compensate — but the radar screen still reads D.CASES directly, so the model change alone will NOT empty it. That gap (model says 3, screen shows 29) is worse than either end state and must not be left standing across releases. Sequence the model commit and the radar commit tightly, or ship them together.

The upstream feeds are tiny and structurally different from the fixture: 3 opportunities, 3 future signals, and the future signals have no STATUS at all. Rebuilding the future screen's seven status chips on real data yields seven zeros. Deriving a status from WHY_WATCH text would violate §7 (presentation may not invent an agronomic state).

IG.CROP_WINDOWS uses ids IT-WIN-001…IT-WIN-007 while ITALY_CANONICAL uses IT-WIN-0001…IT-WIN-0029. Different strings today, but one zero away from a silent collision the moment either side renumbers. The cross-family id assert in STEP 12 must run on the union of ALL families, not per family.

IG.CROP_WINDOWS (7 records, real, Italian-language, with REGULATORY_ACT 'DDR n. 13645 2026-05-14' and explicit COVERAGE_STATE) is real regulatory window evidence that neither the model nor the canonical file reads. Merging it with ITALY_CANONICAL is tempting and dangerous: its ISSUE strings are Italian ('Flavescenza dorata (vetor Scaphoideus titanus)'), its CROP strings are Italian codes (VITE, OLIVO), and its OBSERVED_STAGE is literally 'NAO SEI'. It belongs in its own slot with its own vocabulary, not merged.

Several real records carry Portuguese working-notes as values (EXHIBITOR_LIST_STATE 'NAO CONSULTADA', OBSERVED_STAGE 'NAO SEI', timing 'NAO SEI — a coluna de epoca do rotulo nao foi extraida'). These are unknown-markers written in the research team's language, and if rendered raw they both break §11 (Italian default) and read as data. The normalize layer must map them to the model's NOT_EXTERNALLY_OBSERVABLE / UNKNOWN constants, not translate them.

PRECEDENCE MERGE — proposal for review. The merge is per FIELD, not per record, and it only ever fills a hole; it never overwrites. mergeField(slot, id, field, value, rank) accepts the value if the slot is empty for that field OR the incoming rank is strictly higher (CANONICAL 1 > REAL_SOURCE 2 > REAL_DERIVED 3 > SYNTHETIC_DEMO 4 > DEMO_SCENARIO 5). Hard rule on top: ranks 4 and 5 may write ONLY to record.ui and to fields listed in an explicit DEMO_WRITABLE allowlist (today: ui.icon, ui.color, ui.order). A rank-4/5 write to any other field is not a lower-precedence merge, it is a rejection (DEMO_PROVENANCE_IN_REAL_SLOT) and it appears in validationReport.demoLeaks[]. Every accepted override is logged in precedenceOverrides[] as {slot,id,field,winner,loser} so a merge can be read after the fact.

VIEW CONTRACT — proposal for review. A record leaving the model exposes exactly: id (stable, namespaced by family, never a fixture id), provenance (one of the five constants), sourceIds[] (possibly empty; emptiness is a fact the UI must render, not hide), ui{icon,color,order} (presentation only), and the family's normalized lowercase domain fields. It exposes NOTHING that identifies the research mission: no package version, no handoff name, no mission id, no scraper, no run timestamp, no file path, no collector. raw is kept for debugging but must be non-enumerable or stripped in the shipped build — today raw carries the full upstream record including PROVENANCE strings and NOTE fields written by the research team. Confirm whether raw ships.
